entries.summary: Initial build: SW, manifest, OneSignal v16, install prompts, nonce endpoint, admin settings
entries.notes: Plugin skeleton, SW written to ABSPATH, manifest to ABSPATH, OneSignal v16 merged SW, Android/iOS install sheets, nonce refresh endpoint at /oha/v1/nonce, admin settings page

entries.summary: Offline map strategy: MapTiler tile caching, Ohio overview tile pre-cache, stale-while-revalidate for map data and listing pages
entries.notes: SW intercepts api.maptiler.com (cache-first), /oha/v1/map/ REST endpoint (stale-while-revalidate), /places/ + /events/ pages (stale-while-revalidate). Ohio tiles z6-8 pre-fetched at SW install via OHIO_TILES injected by write_sw() using the MapTiler key from oha_map_maptiler option. Persistent caches: oha-tiles-v1, oha-map-data-v1.

entries.summary: write_sw() now injects OHIO_TILES_JSON placeholder; on_settings_saved() rebuilds SW as well as manifest
entries.notes: on_settings_saved() now calls write_sw() in addition to write_manifest() so offline URL and tile list stay current when admin settings change.

entries.summary: Added body classes is-oha-member and is-board, inline head pwa-mode detection, offline class toggling in JS
entries.notes: PHP body_class filter adds is-oha-member (oha_member_id meta) and is-board (manage_options or edit_posts). Inline wp_head script adds pwa-mode class before CSS paints. oha-pwa-init.js toggles pwa-offline on online/offline events.

entries.summary: Added CSS visibility utility classes: pwa-show/hide, member-show/hide, oha-member-show/hide, board-show/hide, offline-show/hide
entries.notes: Classes target html.pwa-mode, body.logged-in (WP native), body.is-oha-member, body.is-board. Use via Kadence/Gutenberg Additional CSS class(es) on any block.
